mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases, or if Rank IC <0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates expanding residential construction, which may boost related industries and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases, or if Rank IC <0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased economic activity, which may lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO grows but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases, or if Rank IC <0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >50k jobs in 1 month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases, or if Rank IC <0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases, or if Rank IC <0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals easier monetary conditions, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases, or if Rank IC <0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real federal funds rate adjusted consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which may lead to increased corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases, or if Rank IC <0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) may not lead to positive S&P 500 returns as the labor market is already tight and inflationary pressures may emerge.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases in late-cycle but SPX returns are positive in >40% of cases, or if Rank IC <0.05 over 3 years.
